lines.text: Many learners say: It depends of the weather.
Better: It depends on the weather.

native.tip: بعد depend نستخدم on: “It depends on the weather.” وليس “It depends of the weather.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “It depends of the weather.” 😅 بعد depend نستخدم on، فالجملة الصحيحة “It depends on the weather.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “It depends of the weather”?
en.tip: After depend we use on: “It depends on the weather.” not “It depends of the weather.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “It depends of the weather.” 😅 After depend we use on, so the right sentence is “It depends on the weather.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
